Kitchen: super chill Sunday, good prep for tomorrow. Low: brined olive, bar mix, honey butter quenelle, chicken thighs in brine, hot honey, sliced scallop, basil vinaigrette, burger meat, walnut cilantro pesto. 911: peaches, mixed/artisan greens, agnolotti pasta, white bean succotash. Maintenance: none. Favorite moment: bar couple raved about Dom's hospitality.
